stemMd: A club has 18 members who play chess, 12 who play go, and 7 who play both. One of the chess players is selected at random. What is the probability that the selected member also plays go?
explanationMd: The selection is restricted to the 18 chess players. Seven of those also play go, so the conditional probability is 7/18. The relevant denominator is the group from which selection occurs.

distractorRationale.c: This conditions on go players rather than chess players.
distractorRationale.a: This uses the total union rather than the selected group.
distractorRationale.d: This counts all go players, including those outside the chess group.
